The lookup returns `< 0`, so execution takes the error-report branch immediately below instead of rejecting the missing initialization earlier.

ASan sink. `%s` makes `fprintf` continue reading `phonemes_name` until it finds a NUL byte, so the call runs off the end of the 40-byte stack object left uninitialized by steps 7 and 8.
